verdict.rationale: The Texas Workforce Commission is a state government agency whose online services (UTR/UTS registration, wage reporting, tax payment) keep data under Texas jurisdiction by law. Letting a user pick a storage region or residency is a cloud/SaaS axis and a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows TWC offers any such choice, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
